desc:
Welcome to Parkour bumper 2 ! 🌀😵‍💫

Do you have the courage to complete the weirdest and most annoying tower parkour you'll ever play? 🧗‍♂️
Crazy stages, impossible jumps, and dizzying spins that will leave you lost... all in one tower! 💫

🗺️ Explore the Map:
Explore the tower and its unique stages yourself, and try your best to avoid hidden traps and pranks that pop up out of nowhere! 💣⚠️

🐾 Special Pets:
As you progress and overcome obstacles, you can get pets to accompany you on your journey and stay by your side all the way! 🏆✨

🔥 Challenge yourself, stay focused, and don’t let the headache beat you!
Every step counts... 😆
Overcome all obstacles and show us if you're the true tower champion! 🎮👑

Slap tower troll Obby Parkour
